engines.name: narsil
engines.keyword_setup: BM25 k1=0.9 b=0.4; language english, as the server reports it

engines.name: elasticsearch
engines.keyword_setup: BM25 k1=0.9 b=0.4 (custom default similarity); Elasticsearch `english` analyzer

engines.name: meilisearch
engines.keyword_setup: Not BM25; the harness sets `searchableAttributes` to the text field, sets `stopWords` to the Lucene English list the BM25 engines analyze with, searches with `matchingStrategy` `frequency` so a long question drops its commonest words first, reads `_rankingScore` as the score, and leaves every other setting at its default

engines.name: opensearch
engines.keyword_setup: BM25 k1=0.9 b=0.4 (custom default similarity); OpenSearch `english` analyzer

engines.name: typesense
engines.keyword_setup: Not BM25; the harness creates the text field with locale `en` and `stem` enabled, applies the Lucene English stop words the BM25 engines analyze with, sets `drop_tokens_threshold` to the number of results requested so a long question drops words until that many documents match, sorts by `_text_match`, and leaves every other setting at its default
